governing_instruments.title: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) Maharashtra Guidelines

decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.
Minimum age of 18 years and maximum age of 45 years (relaxable up to 50 years for SC, ST, Women and Divyang).

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Maximum age of 45 years (up to 50 years for reserved/women)
decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: Minimum age of 18 years and maximum age of 45 years (relaxable up to 50 years for SC, ST, Women and Divyang).

exclusions.plain_en: Excludes candidates who have already availed financial subsidy under PMEGP or CMEGP
exclusions.verbatim_quote: Subsidy ranging from 15% to 35% of project cost with bank loan facilitation.
